scope: Local production-build Chromium and unit/API tests; Demo data fixtures only; no deployment or verified external authority integration.

checks.check: CSV/Excel upload, template, mapping, preview and row errors
checks.finding: Added bounded XLSX reading and visible-sheet selection; real CSV header-only templates. The browser parsed and imported an XLSX fixture, changed an actual column mapping, downloaded the exact original and exercised row errors.

checks.check: Required source, publisher, date, licence and link
checks.finding: All five fields are required on the server and in the form. Links are retained, never fetched; embedded credentials are rejected. Source date cannot be in the future in the India calendar.
Demo and Manually provided · unverified badges work. An upload cannot select or assert Official; all receipts have sourceVerified:false.
checks.remaining: An independently verified source and an authorized verification policy are needed before an Official status can be supported.

checks.finding: Import completeness counts nonempty transformed cells over all category schema cells. Required-field completeness is separate. Service completeness counts available service inputs. Neither certifies accuracy.

checks.check: Upload history, original preservation and rollback
checks.finding: Confirmed imports persist original bytes, hash, mapping, classification, provenance and timestamps. Authorized rollback requires confirmation and a reason, retains audit evidence, excludes archived batches and protects dependent imports.

checks.check: Missing-dataset empty states and upload prompt
checks.finding: All seven real-data categories currently report not_provided. Readiness and empty states link to the working onboarding interface.

Missing factors are not treated as zero. Weights are normalized over available factors; unavailable weighted inputs and missing service cells mark results Partial. No usable factor yields an unavailable score.

checks.check: Map/ward table, search, combined filters, sorting and ranking
checks.finding: Shared records drive map and paginated directory. Stable-ID selections synchronize the polygon and table. Live street tiles and blocked-provider fallback both passed.
Existing comparison workflow is preserved. Methodology adds weight previews and authorized saved weights; a browser save and refresh confirmed SQLite persistence.

checks.check: CSV and PDF exports with sources and dates
checks.finding: CSV contains all filtered report fields, source/save/export metadata, localized display headers and formula protection. Browser Print / Save as PDF generated real PDFs in all three languages; every page was rendered for QA.
checks.remaining: PDF is a browser print workflow and summarizes the first nine display columns; CSV contains all fields. This scope is explained in the interface.

checks.check: Source and date under data charts, cards and tables
checks.finding: Shared source captions and explicit summary/related-record captions label Demo data, generator source and actual workspace save time. Imported previews/history show the supplied source and source date, or unavailable.
checks.remaining: Workspace save time is explicitly labelled Saved; it is not a claimed real measurement date.

checks.finding: A valid CSV and XLSX import completed in disposable SQLite with explicit provenance and confirmation. GeoJSON import also passed the regression browser suite.
Missing identifier mapping was reported; manually mapping the real code column allowed validation. Missing row values and mappings are rejected.
Nonnumeric coverage/counts, bad dates, invalid ranges and formulas produce clear errors; numeric row errors retain source row 2.
Duplicate identifiers fail validation; cross-batch conflicts cannot silently overwrite records. Exact active retries are idempotent.
Zero-byte and header-only files are rejected without a new import or fake success.
A file of 5 MiB + 1 byte was rejected by both UI and API. It was not read into a preview or persisted.

checks.check: Workbook units, worksheet choice and safe formulas
checks.finding: Percentage-formatted 0.75 becomes displayed 75 with a disclosure; selected-sheet metadata is real. Original bytes stay unchanged. Formula/error cells are never evaluated.

checks.check: Hardcoded application text and resource parity
checks.finding: AST/key checks found no unhandled application JSX text, missing literal translation calls, missing parameters or missing locale keys. The three locale files each have 255 keys; the merged catalogue has 3012.

Missing keys: none. Parameter mismatches: none. Intentionally unchanged technical labels: CSV, SHA-256:, and · CTS in Hindi and Marathi (six entries). Proper names, source values, IDs, URLs and technical formulas remain unchanged.

Intl en-IN/hi-IN/mr-IN formatting is shared across UI and print reports. Full timestamps use Asia/Kolkata; calendar-only dates retain their day. CSV machine values retain ISO dates and numeric semantics, with localized display headers.
English, Hindi and Marathi selections persisted across reloads in actual browser tests and updated the full current UI.

checks.check: Errors, tooltips, empty states, exports and methodology
checks.finding: Resource and parameter checks, nine populated upload previews, field-error switching and all-language PDF/CSV exports passed. Unknown uploaded source text is preserved rather than invented or mistranslated.
Self-hosted Noto Sans Devanagari, with its OFL and source/hash manifest, loaded in Hindi and Marathi browser screens. Representative full-size screenshots and all PDF pages were visually inspected.

checks.check: Native Hindi and Marathi language quality
checks.finding: There is no native-speaker certification. The review CSV lists all 104 new/overridden audit strings in English/Hindi/Marathi. Existing translations also remain linguistically unverified.
checks.remaining: A native Hindi and Marathi reviewer should review technical and civic terminology, especially the examples listed below.

checks.check: Every page at 375 / 768 / 1280 in three languages
checks.finding: 23 page/detail/dialog states × 3 widths × 3 languages = 207 screenshots, plus nine populated upload previews. Automated overflow/key/accessibility checks passed. Contact sheets cover every combination; full-size representative screens were inspected.

checks.check: Overflow, overlap, spacing, theme and readable tables
checks.finding: The examined states have no document overflow. Tables scroll within labelled keyboard-focusable regions. Pale background, navy text, teal controls, rounded white cards and Devanagari typography remain consistent.
Backend failure and Retry recovery, missing datasets, zero assessments/feedback, unavailable tiles, invalid uploads and failed saves were exercised without invented success or metrics.

checks.check: Keyboard navigation, dialog focus and focus indicators
checks.finding: Native dialogs, semantic controls, visible focus, skip link and horizontally scrollable tables are retained. Mobile navigation traps focus, closes with Escape and restores focus.

checks.check: Labels, alt text and automated accessibility
checks.finding: WCAG 2 A/AA and 2.1 AA axe checks report no violations in the 216 examined states. Brand artwork is decorative inside a labelled button; controls have accessible labels.

Charts include numeric values and text labels. Status and selection are not conveyed by colour alone. Contrast fixes cover active controls, headers, selected-row links, muted text and validation timestamps.
Automated Chromium checks and keyboard tests are evidence, not a screen-reader certification.
checks.remaining: A manual review with the intended screen reader/device remains useful before public deployment.

checks.check: Seeded fictional city and ward names
checks.finding: The seed=96 CLI generated byte-identical files twice. Demo City 96 contains only numbered fictional Demo Ward and Demo Settlement source names; no real ward/slum names are generated.
All active entity collections and nested operation/indicator histories receive explicit flags. Existing stored civic values were preserved while adding metadata.
A visible banner and header indicator remain across every route. Ordinary record display names stay concise; stable DEMO IDs and fictional source names are preserved.

checks.check: Demo data badges on data visualizations
checks.finding: Shared Panels, Tables, Progress bars, summary cards, mini cards, related records and map source captions carry the badge.
CSV notice and record metadata, JSON source flags and all PDF pages identify Demo data. The exact English watermark remains in multilingual exports.
Supplied batches cannot enter the synthetic adapter or rankings. Imports stay active:false and sourceVerified:false. There is no mixed-source ranking option.
checks.remaining: A future mixed-source opt-in, warning and compatible source-specific methodology have not been implemented; no mixing is currently possible.

checks.finding: Changing a service estimate recalculates household-weighted before/after values for the same settlement collection. It is explicitly a preview and does not alter saved indicators.
Actual priority order and service gaps determine households needing coverage. User-supplied budget/unit cost are assumptions; cents-based allocation cannot exceed the budget and skips unknown inputs.
Previewed rankings update immediately; all-zero weights fail validation. Authorized saved weights survived refresh in the browser test.

Three separate seeded fixtures test household ratio >8, service coverage <10%, and a missing service value. The real predicates caught 3/3. Active settlement metrics are never overwritten by planted cases.

Elapsed time is derived from actual stored submission/resolution timestamps; missing/invalid resolution dates stay unavailable. High/medium/low 2/7/14-day targets are explicitly demo assumptions. Filtering and pagination work.
Unfinished projects past expected end dates are High; overdue unfinished milestones produce Watch. The rule does not imply an official risk assessment or resolve complaints.
An actual separate 10,000-settlement workload generated, validated, filtered and sorted in 420.81 ms on this machine. It did not persist or change active counts.
checks.remaining: This is a local generator/validation/filter/sort diagnostic, not a concurrent-user test or a 10,000-polygon browser-load guarantee.

checks.finding: The methodology explains fixed-seed generation, fictional geometry, household-weighted coverage, service gaps, factor scales, missing data, targets, anomaly rules, budget assumptions and source isolation.

checks.check: Settlement detail, housing and six basic services
checks.finding: Profile, linked records, targets, gaps and inspection history use shared IDs and records; absent values remain unavailable.

checks.check: Issue creation, follow-up and dashboard updates
checks.finding: Public issue creation persists to SQLite before success; authorized status/assignment/notes produce actual history and activity. Allowed transitions match the backend.
Creation, progress editing, required milestone completion dates, rejected keys and reload persistence passed in a disposable database.

checks.check: Visits, cancellation and explicit indicator updates
checks.finding: Scheduling/cancellation persist; completing a visit does not silently change indicators. Applying findings requires an explicit confirmed operation with a change history.
Creation, editing and public read-only details work; no official eligibility or personal information is invented.
Feedback and responses persist. Administrative changes retain previous responses and status transitions in actual events.

checks.check: Reports and dashboard use the same filtered records
checks.finding: Settlement-scoped report summaries and infrastructure use the same records as the supporting table. Open/upcoming metrics and navigation apply matching filters.

checks.check: Scoped reset and replaceable persistence adapter
checks.finding: Confirmed reset restores deterministic demo records and preserves controlled source imports. Existing SQLite/RecordStore and CivicAdapter architecture remain intact.
No old boundary/KML requests were observed in the browser regression. Original source files were not deleted or replaced.
No external government/authority service is configured or tested. All seven real-data categories are honestly Not provided. Controlled uploads are real isolated imports, not production activation.
checks.remaining: Provide authorized sources, definitions/licences/dates, validated geographic crosswalks, credentials where needed, security/access controls, retention, monitoring and backups.

checks.finding: The running server has adminConfigured:false. Protected routes correctly explain the limitation; authorized and rejected-key flows were exercised with temporary credentials.
checks.remaining: Set a private NAGARSEVA_OFFICER_KEY before starting the API and enter it in Data management to use protected actions locally. No secret was invented or printed.

checks.finding: Current photoStorage:false is truthful. Form/API validation exists; private attachment-storage tests use isolated configuration.
checks.remaining: Enable the existing URBANSAARTHI_EVIDENCE_STORAGE=sqlite option if photo persistence is desired. Production storage/privacy policy remains a separate decision.
